title: Design System: Thai Lion Air GSE Operations Console

headline.purpose: Dashboard operational headings and modal headers.

body.purpose: Table cells, form inputs, and operational notes.

label.purpose: Form labels, status badges, and table headers (12.5px minimum).

mono.purpose: Equipment identifiers (TLM-xx-xxx), Work Order badges, and tabular operational telemetry.

shadows.name: surface-rest
shadows.purpose: Subtle elevation for cards and sticky headers.

shadows.name: overlay-high
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs, floating overflow menus, and toasts.

motion.name: ease-control
motion.purpose: Fast, crisp state transitions on interactive buttons and panels (0.15s–0.2s, suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion).

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: Primary operational action such as create CM request or save PM task card.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">สร้างใบแจ้งซ่อมใหม่</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:9px 18px; border-radius:8px; border:1.5px solid transparent; font-family:'Sarabun',sans-serif; font-size:0.95rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background:#E31837; color:#FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#B91430; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2.5px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Outline Secondary Button
components.description: Default light-surface secondary action and modal close trigger.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-outline">ปิดหน้าต่าง</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:9px 18px; border-radius:8px; font-family:'Sarabun',sans-serif; font-size:0.95rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-outline { background:#FFFFFF; color:#334155; border:1.5px solid #CBD5E1; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:#F8FAFC; border-color:#475569; color:#0F172A; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2.5px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Approval Success Button
components.description: Manager approval and positive verification CTA meeting WCAG AA contrast.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-success">Manager อนุมัติ (COMPLETE)</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:9px 18px; border-radius:8px; border:none; font-family:'Sarabun',sans-serif; font-size:0.95rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-success { background:#15803D; color:#FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-success:hover { background:#166534; } .ds-btn-success:focus-visible { outline:2.5px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Equipment Code Tag
components.description: Monospace operational identifier for GSE vehicles (TLM-xx-xxx).
components.css: .ds-eq-code { display:inline-block; font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace; font-weight:700; font-size:0.86rem; color:#0F172A; background:#F1F5F9; border:1px solid #CBD5E1; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:6px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.description: High-contrast status pill covering CM and PM approval lifecycle.

components.name: Operational Input Field
components.description: Accessible form input with AA placeholder contrast and visible focus ring.
components.html: <input type="text" class="ds-input" placeholder="เช่น TLM-TR-025">
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; padding:9px 12px; border:1.5px solid #CBD5E1; border-radius:8px; font-family:'Sarabun',sans-serif; font-size:0.95rem; color:#0F172A; background:#FFFFFF; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#55657A; opacity:1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2.5px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset:1px; border-color:#1D4ED8; }

narrative.overview:
Built for Don Mueang (DMK) ramp, hangar, and maintenance control teams, this system prioritizes immediate operational clarity under bright outdoor sunlight and rapid one-handed smartphone workflows. Thai Lion Air Crimson (#E31837) anchors only the brand shell and primary action moments, leaving the operational workspace on cool Aviation Slate surfaces where equipment identifiers (TLM-xx-xxx), Work Order tags, and workflow statuses stand out cleanly without competing visual clutter.

Every interface decision respects Google Apps Script's HtmlService payload budget: crisp semantic CSS tokens replace duplicated inline markup, and screen components remain separated from pixel-calibrated A4 print overlays.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast outdoor readability (>= 4.5:1 WCAG AA across badges, buttons, and placeholders).
Single primary action per table row paired with an overflow menu (...) instead of multi-color icon clusters.
Monospace equipment tags and tabular numerals across all Work Orders, dates, HR meters, and KPI counters.
Guardrailed safety forms: unchecked PM checklists by default, live progress counters, local draft autosave, and confirmation dialogs before regulatory signatures or deletions.

rules.name: The Earned Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep Thai Lion Air Crimson for the top shell and primary creation/submission actions; use Aviation Slate, Navy, and Teal for routine workspace controls so critical alerts and active repairs command immediate attention.

rules.name: The Full-Perimeter Border Rule
rules.body: Never apply a thick one-sided left/top accent stripe on rounded cards or banners; communicate category with clean full borders, tinted backgrounds, or leading icons.

rules.name: The 12.5px Floor Rule
rules.body: Never set screen UI text below 0.78rem (~12.5px) outside calibrated A4 paper overlays.

rules.name: The Tabular Data Rule
rules.body: Every numeric ID, W/O badge, date, and counter uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Neutral Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never apply colored neon/glow shadows to buttons, banners, or cards; depth is strictly neutral slate.

dos: Do validate every screen color pair to >= 4.5:1 contrast (including ::placeholder, navbar tabs, and status pills).
Do keep new PM Task Card checklists unchecked by default with explicit section/all confirmation and live progress feedback.
Do preserve calibrated A4 print overlay coordinates (#printPage, #pmPrintPage, #pmWeeklySummaryPrintPage) untouched.
Do reuse semantic CSS classes in Stylesheet.html instead of writing inline style="..." blocks so GAS payload stays lean.
donts: Don't use purple/violet (#7C3AED / #8B5CF6) accents, infinite pulsing dots, or one-sided border-left stripes on rounded containers.
Don't cram 6-7 icon-only rainbow buttons into desktop table cells or expose unlabelled inputs without <label for> / aria-label.
Don't emit bare outline: none without :focus-visible ring styling.
